data.title: Canadian publisher drops novelist after AI confirmation
data.description: MONTREAL - The publisher of the top-selling Haitian-Canadian writer Thelyson Orelien says it has confirmed that he used artificial intelligence to help write his novel.

data.title: 125 laughing gas cylinders seized from Bangkok condo
data.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old man and seized 125 cylinders of nitrous oxide, commonly known as laughing gas, and related items in a raid on a condominium in Lat Phrao district of Bangkok.

data.title: MotoGP riders to bid ‘emotional’ farewell to Phillip Island
data.description: PHILLIP ISLAND, Australia - Seven-time world champion Marc Marquez admits it will be “emotional” this weekend as one of MotoGP’s most iconic circuits at Phillip Island hosts its last race after nearly three decades.

data.title: Chinese fugitive’s toddler registered as Thai child of ‘fake father’
data.description: PATTAYA - Immigration police say a Chinese man wanted in his home country for running a major gambling business had his biological daughter registered as the child of a Thai man to obtain Thai nationality.

data.title: Washington’s $14bn arms sale to Taiwan stalls

data.title: US orders embassy staff, families to leave Saudi Arabia

data.title: New rescue bid as ‘celebrity shark’ returns to Busan canal
data.description: SEOUL - A shark that became a viral sensation after getting stuck in a South Korean canal returned hours after being coaxed out, authorities said on Thursday, prompting another attempt to guide it back to the sea.

data.title: Global Executives Discuss Job Creation & Workforce Skills in AI Economy
data.description: Senior executives from the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group, Standard Chartered Bank, Microsoft Asia and Accenture discussed economic growth in the age of AI at the panel discussion “Powering The Future Economy – Growth, Technology, and Sustainability”.
